items.title: 6.2.1 Basic Concepts of Cloud Computing (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of basic cloud concepts (PDF 155).

blocks.text: Cloud computing chand bunyadi tasawwurat par khari hai: virtualization, scalability aur elasticity, aur on-demand access.

blocks.alt: Baen: chaar column, apna PC, IaaS, PaaS aur SaaS, har ek applications se hardware tak chhe tehon ka dher, rang se dikhaya gaya ke har teh user sambhalta hai ya provider. Daen: ek machine teen virtual machines mein bati hui, scalability, elasticity, on-demand access aur pay as you go ke notes ke saath. Neeche: public, private, hybrid aur multi-cloud ke dabbe misalon ke saath.
blocks.caption: Cloud service models, bunyadi khayalat aur deployment models (topic 6.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Apne computer par aap har teh khud sambhalte hain. IaaS mein provider hardware aur virtualization chalata hai jabke aap operating system, runtime, data aur applications sambhalte hain; PaaS mein provider operating system aur runtime bhi chalata hai, to aap sirf apna data aur application sambhalte hain; SaaS mein provider sab kuch chalata hai aur aap bas software istemal karte hain. Virtualization ek physical machine ko kai virtual machines bana deti hai. Public clouds mushtarak aur saste, private clouds ek idare ke liye mehfooz, hybrid clouds dono ka mel, aur multi-cloud mazbooti ke liye kai providers istemal karta hai.

blocks.prompt: Cloud computing ke bunyadi tasawwurat bataiye.
blocks.explanation: Virtualization, scalability aur elasticity, aur on-demand access.
